learned: 2026-10-05, by an agent pass: the products post type's RSS feed, 51 items on 6 pages of 10. /our-products/ renders 4 cards a section and pages the rest through admin-ajax.php with the page number in the POST body, which a recipe cannot vary; the post type is not in the REST API and not in the sitemap.
notes: The feed 404s past its last page, and a 404 fails the whole fetch: if check says 'fetch failed: HTTP Error 404', lower pages.to; if the last page has 10 items, raise it. It is newest first, so a short pages.to drops the oldest products.

Each feed item has title, category (Flower, Pre-Rolls, Variety Packs, Concentrates, Edibles; 'Featured' rides along) and guid; description and content are empty. The product cards' COA links name the format and size ('3.5G-Whole-Flower-Pine-Sap-OG.pdf', '...-1G-Pre-roll-_-Sold-1-per-pack-Nutter-Budder.pdf'), but the feed has no COA.

Sizes: from the title when it has one (Dime Bag 1g, Upstate Retreat 7g, packs '5-pk of .6g', 'Cousin's Walk .35g ... 5pk'); otherwise flower is 3.5g and a pre-roll is a 1g single, as every sized COA on the product cards says.
Skipped: edibles (Awaken, Inspire, Serenity: no dose in the feed), infused singles with no size in the title, and two uncategorised posts ('Topical Test', 'NEW: DISCO SNOWMAN').
The same strain is a flower and a pre-roll product (Pine Sap OG, Ghost Train Haze); the category tells them apart. 'Jelly Dounutz' is the site's spelling.

'“Cousin’s Walk” .35g Infused Pre-Roll – 5pk' is read as the line Cousin’s Walk with no strain: the site never names the strain, while stores sell it as 'Cousin Walkers Tangerine Cream' (1.75g). The concentrate two-pack (0.5g Sister’s Cheese & 0.5g Apricot Scone) is named after its first strain.
Check on 2026-10-05: 44 entries; stores sell 14 products, 13 found; the one store-only is that Cousin Walkers Tangerine Cream pack.

skip.why: edible: no dose in the feed
infused pre-roll: size not in the feed
